parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term entropy of a system.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
State and explain whether the entropy change of each of the following processes is positive or negative. Do not consider the entropy change of the surroundings.

- liquid water at $80^{\circ}\text{C}$ is cooled to $60^{\circ}\text{C}$

- solid calcium chloride is added to water and the mixture is stirred

- the change corresponding to the lattice energy of calcium chloride, $\Delta H_{\text{latt}}$ $\text{CaCl}_2\text{(s)}$, takes place

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: The reaction $\text{ZnCO}_3\text{(s)} \rightarrow \text{ZnO}\text{(s)} + \text{CO}_2\text{(g)}$ is not spontaneous at room temperature.
parts.text: Give the full name for the term $\Delta G^{\ominus}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Describe how the temperature at which the reaction becomes spontaneous can be calculated. Include an equation in your answer.
